The French adjective naïf and English naive label the same indexed Grothendieck-group constructions. For each exact category named at IV1.6–1.8 and the corresponding two index rows, send every generating class [E] to [E]. This respects every relation [E]=[E′]+[E″] from the same short exact sequences, so it descends to a homomorphism; the identical assignment is its inverse. The replacement preserves text-style typography and changes only the English adjective at four index uses.
